answer: Mechanism: Operator-Cluster Liability (OCL). Each agent runtime presents a TEE/cloud-account attestation binding its wallets to one operator ID. The protocol aggregates wallets per operator; above a marble-set diversity threshold, the operator’s whole cluster enters a jade throttle—shrinking quotas, delayed payouts—then suspension. Sanctions hit the operator ID: future registrations, API keys, payouts, not wallets. Attacker cost: rent many independent attested runtimes/accounts and lose entire clusters on detection; sybil wallets earn nectar but no usable capacity.
